fix.summary: Add Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin to all responses via HEADERS.
fix.risk: Cross-origin hotlinking or embedding of images/scripts via no-cors would now be blocked by browsers.

patch:
diff --git a/server.js b/server.js
index d1ca314..d9fd1ff 100644
--- a/server.js
+++ b/server.js
@@ -16,6 +16,7 @@ const HEADERS = {
   'referrer-policy': 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
   'permissions-policy': 'geolocation=(), microphone=(), camera=(), interest-cohort=()',
   'cross-origin-opener-policy': 'same-origin-allow-popups',
+  'cross-origin-resource-policy': 'same-origin',
   'content-security-policy': "frame-ancestors 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'",
   server: 'nginx',
 };
